facts: Iceland is the cool scenic leg; ocean swimming is not part of this route.
Geothermal pools provide the water reset before the warm Mediterranean leg.

budget.provenance: iceland-ischia-cilento canonical budget allocation for four Reykjavík nights, rental car, food, pools and parking

days.heading: Reykjavík arrival + geothermal reset

facts.label: Water
facts.valueHtml: Heated geothermal pool, not an ocean swim

days.note: Keep the first day compact: settle in, walk the harbor, and use Laugardalslaug as the jet-lag reset.

spots.name: Reykjavík waterfront
spots.cost: City walk free; municipal pool pricing should be rechecked for 2027.
spots.climate: Long daylight, cool air and fast-changing weather; carry a waterproof layer.

days.heading: Golden Circle + Secret Lagoon
days.note: Start early, keep the geothermal soak as the soft landing after the sightseeing loop, and do not confuse it with the warm-water beach requirement later in Italy.

spots.name: Golden Circle

images.alt: Strokkur erupting into a textured sky

spots.cost: Natural sites are free; budget for fuel, parking if introduced, and the family geothermal entry.
spots.climate: Exposed and windy even on bright days.

days.heading: South Coast waterfalls + Reynisfjara
days.daycost: Est. $180-$280 · long car day and meals

facts.label: Safety
facts.valueHtml: Never turn your back on Reynisfjara surf

days.note: This is the weather-flex day: go when the South Coast forecast is best and keep generous driving margin.

spots.name: Iceland South Coast

images.alt: Seljalandsfoss from the path behind the water
images.credit: Iceland Photo Tours · Google Images source

images.alt: Black sand and sea stacks at Reynisfjara

spots.cost: Natural sights are free; the cost is the rental day, fuel and a road meal.
spots.climate: Cold spray and Atlantic wind make waterproof layers essential.

days.heading: Reykjanes weather-flex + optional Blue Lagoon
days.feel: Steam, lava and a softer final day
days.daycost: Est. $160-$460 · car, meals and optional lagoon

facts.label: Route
facts.valueHtml: Gunnuhver → lava coast → optional Blue Lagoon

facts.label: Rule
facts.valueHtml: Use this day to recover a missed flagship loop first

days.note: The fourth night is weather insurance. Drive the compact Reykjanes loop only if the Golden Circle and South Coast already succeeded; add Blue Lagoon only when the live price fits.

spots.name: Reykjanes weather-flex

images.alt: Steaming rust, cream and blue mud pools of the Seltún–Krýsuvík geothermal field
images.credit: Ragna Ólöf Guðmundsdóttir · Google Images source

images.alt: Vivid green moss over black lava on the Reykjanes Peninsula
Blue Lagoon geothermal water amid black lava

spots.cost: Gunnuhver and the coast are free; Blue Lagoon is optional and must be repriced for 2027.
spots.climate: Keep this day movable and follow current road, weather and volcanic-access guidance.

days.heading: Fly KEF → Rome
days.daycost: Transfer priced in the route edge

facts.label: 2027 gate
facts.valueHtml: Book only after exact operating day is published

days.note: Use the nonstop KEF–FCO if its 2027 operating day matches; otherwise reject the split rather than add an exhausting European connection.
days.travelNote: Allow time after FCO arrival for the train to Naples and hydrofoil to Ischia.
